state.message:
Hello,
The battery in my Vela Mini drains extremely fast, and I need it working today to deliver a presentation to my board, so I want either a refund or a replacement laptop.
Regards,
Morgan

queue.instructions: Which Contoso support queue should take this case? Contoso support policy. Swollen battery, smoke or burning smell: depot_repair, never onsite, urgency 3. Personal-data export or deletion: privacy_desk, urgency 2 with a legal deadline, else 1. Invoices and orders: sales_ops. Error BAT-047 with a battery complaint: battery_program if battery_cycles < 500 and days_since_purchase <= 730, else sales_ops (paid quote), even when the customer asks for a refund. BIOS-0x1F/BIOS-0x2A or no boot after a firmware update: bios_l2 (urgency 2 if it does not boot). NPU-118, DSP-330, drivers, Windows and Contoso apps: remote_l1. Drops, spills and cracked screens: damage_claim only under an active Accidental Damage 2Y plan, else sales_ops. Overheating (THM-212): remote_l1 first except on Titan G7 or when the remote fan-profile reset already failed; then it is a hardware fault. Hardware faults: sales_ops when out of warranty (Standard 1Y 365 days, Accidental Damage 2Y 730 days, Premium Care 3Y 1095 days); onsite_repair and onsite_eligible only with an active Premium Care 3Y plan in CN, JP, DE or US; otherwise depot_repair. Urgency 3 for a failing disk without a backup, 2 when the customer must work today, else 1; software and sales cases without a same-day need are 0.

我的 Contoso Nimbus 2-in-1 转轴已经松得晃来晃去，机器从来没摔过也没进过水，正常使用还能出这种问题，实在让人生气，请帮我处理。
谢谢

queue.instructions: Which Contoso support queue should take this case? Contoso support policy. Swollen battery, smoke or burning smell: depot_repair, never onsite, urgency 3. Personal-data export or deletion: privacy_desk, urgency 2 with a legal deadline, else 1. Invoices and orders: sales_ops. Error BAT-047 with a battery complaint: battery_program if battery_cycles < 500 and days_since_purchase <= 730, else sales_ops (paid quote), even when the customer asks for a refund. BIOS-0x1F/BIOS-0x2A or no boot after a firmware update: bios_l2 (urgency 2 if it does not boot). NPU-118, DSP-330, drivers, Windows and Contoso apps: remote_l1. Drops, spills and cracked screens: damage_claim only under an active Accidental Damage 2Y plan, else sales_ops. Overheating (THM-212): remote_l1 first except on Titan G7 or when the remote fan-profile reset already failed; then it is a hardware fault. Hardware faults: sales_ops when out of warranty (Standard 1Y 365 days, Accidental Damage 2Y 730 days, Premium Care 3Y 1095 days); onsite_repair and onsite_eligible only with an active Premium Care 3Y plan in CN, JP, DE or US; otherwise depot_repair. Urgency 3 for a failing disk without a backup, 2 when the customer must work today, else 1; software and sales cases without a same-day need are 0.
